jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Polish OR Lituanian OR Czech - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: NTT DATA - API / SOA Architect
jobs.description:
NTT Data is looking for an experienced API / SOA Architect to help design and drive enterprise integration and API strategies within complex and large-scale environments.

As API / SOA Architect, you will define architecture standards, API governance frameworks, security principles, and integration roadmaps that support digital transformation and enterprise interoperability.

We welcome Junior, Medior, and Senior professionals who have experience in API management, integration architecture, cloud-native technologies, and modern service-oriented architectures.
Key responsibilities

• Define API and SOA architecture strategies and standards

• Design REST, SOAP and MicroServices-based integration solutions

• Define API governance and lifecycle Management Frameworks

• Establish security standards using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT and related protocols

• Lead architecture reviews and technical design workshops

• Collaborate with business, development, DevOps, infrastructure and security teams

• Drive DevSecOps, CI/CD and automation initiatives

• Design scalable and reusable enterprise integration patterns

• Produce architecture documentation, guidelines and recommendations

• Support API platform adoption and continuous improvement

What we are looking for

A strong communicator with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills who can work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. You should have a passion for architecture, integration, automation and continuous improvement.

About NTT Data:

NTT Data is a trusted global innovator of IT and business services, helping clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, technology modernization and managed services.

• Higher education degree or equivalent experience

• Junior (>1 year), Medior (>3 years), or Senior (>10 years) experience

• Strong understanding of API Architecture and SOA principles

• Experience with REST and SOAP services

• Knowledge of OpenAPI, Swagger, YAML, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT and Jwk

• Experience with API Management Platforms such as Apigee, Axway, WSO2, Red Hat Fuse or similar

• Strong understanding of Java Enterprise environments

• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns and SOA Design Patterns

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies

• Experience with testing methodologies, DevOps and CI/CD

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP

• Experience with source control and collaboration tools including GIT, Jira and Confluence

• Languages:

• Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory)

• Professional working proficiency in Dutch and/or French (mandatory)

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders

• Technology environment: Java EE, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Apache CXF, Docker, OpenShift, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Jenkins, Maven, GIT, Snyk, sonarqube, Neo4j, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, OpenAPI and Swagger.

jobs.occupation: Data Business Analyst (with SAP BW)
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a “Data Business Analyst” for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Long term vision

 

Context :

We are looking for an experienced Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and Data Engineering teams. In this role, you will play a key part in translating business needs into scalable data solutions while supporting the transformation from an SAP-based landscape to a modern cloud data platform. You will contribute to both the maintenance of the current SAP BW environment and the evolution of the future data architecture.

Description :

As a Data Business Analyst, you will gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into functional and technical data specifications. You will design data mappings, transformation logic, and KPI definitions, while collaborating on conceptual and logical data models. Your responsibilities will also include SQL analysis, data profiling, and data quality assessments, as well as producing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Specifications. You will lead root cause analyses for data discrepancies and pipeline issues, define and execute testing and UAT activities, and contribute to data governance through documentation and metadata management. A strong background in SAP BW, SAP data extraction processes, SQL, data warehousing (ETL, Star/Snowflake schemas), and logical and physical data modelling is essential. Experience with Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SAP SD/MM, or within a retail or large enterprise environment is considered an asset.
 

Your Profile :

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, and have proven experience as a Data Business Analyst or in a similar consulting role. You are comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, with excellent communication skills that enable you to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are analytical, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Fluency in English is mandatory, together with French or Dutch.

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.
